summary.headline: Shriram Properties Q2 FY27 sales rose ~20% QoQ to INR583 crores and EBITDA more than tripled YoY to INR62 crores, but net debt rose to INR761 crores.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 sales were INR583 crores, up about 20% QoQ, on 0.91 million sq ft, with launches in Chennai and Kolkata selling 50% and 75% of inventory respectively. Revenue rose 19% YoY to INR272 crores, EBITDA rose from about INR18.6 crores to INR62.4 crores (about 23% margin), and PAT rose 151% YoY to INR21.6 crores. Five JVs and three key projects were converted into wholly owned subsidiaries, which lifted gross external debt to INR1,118 crores and net debt to INR761 crores (net debt-to-equity 0.29 to 0.51 in H1). Management reiterated FY27 guidance, which is heavily H2-weighted and depends on launches, approvals and handovers.

segments.name: Kolkata
segments.commentary: Accounted for about 50% of H1 revenue. Plotted development (290-292 plots, ~480,000 sq ft) is about 75% sold; villas sold quickly, and management sees ~INR6.5-7 crore per acre contribution before land cost for plotted and ~INR6-7 crore per acre for villas.

segments.name: Chennai
segments.commentary: Recent launch with 50% of inventory sold; Park 63 and Shankari were major Q2 revenue contributors. Gateway C-Zone launch targeted for Q4.

segments.name: Pune
segments.commentary: Management cited Pune as the strongest growth market PAN India at 20% QoQ. Manjari (~2.3 million sq ft integrated township) launch slipped from Q2 to Q3 pending approvals; plan sanction expected in about 20 days.

segments.name: Bengaluru
segments.commentary: Planned launches at Bannerghatta Road, Yelahanka, Doddagubbi, Sarjapura from Nov-Feb. 107 Southeast has ~796 pending handovers; Esquire is also an H2 handover contributor.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue recognition now guided at INR1,500-1,600 crores (about 20% growth; initially stated as INR1,300-1,500 crores before correction on the call), with OC-led handovers of ~INR1,400 crores still ahead.
FY27 EBITDA guided at around INR300 crores (roughly 20%+ margin); PAT margin 8-10% for now, stabilising around 10-11% long term.
FY28 mission targets (INR5,000 crores pre-sales, INR2,500 crores revenue, ~INR250 crores PBT) reaffirmed, though management said the slide was missing and it is under review.
Net debt expected to rise by only INR200-250 crores more before March; management comfort zone on net debt-to-equity is 0.7-0.75, with a preference to stay below 0.5.
Launches of 5.25 million sq ft planned in H2 FY27 out of 5.93 million sq ft for the year, subject to approvals; 9 projects in the H2 pipeline.
capex_capacity: Ongoing projects: ~15.5 million sq ft, with ~13.3 million sq ft sold and ~2.2 million sq ft unsold (unsold GDV ~INR1,400 crores); upcoming projects 17.7 million sq ft (~INR11,560 crores GDV).

Five JVs and three key projects (107 Southeast, WYT Field, 122 West) converted into wholly owned subsidiaries; management estimates ~INR1,800 crores of GDV/revenue potential now consolidated over completion periods.
H1 operating outflows INR404 crores; investment in new projects INR105 crores in H1 (INR17 crores in Q2). Free cash flow before new project investment INR289 crores in H1.
Kolkata: ~105 acres of net developable land; management plans development-led monetisation over 3-5 years, with ~INR2,000 crores of undiscounted cash flow from the site.
Business development: ~8.8-9 million sq ft (~INR7,500-8,000 crores GDV) at documentation stage, with 21 projects under evaluation; a Mumbai/MMR entry is being evaluated.
demand_pricing: Management said market demand is better, citing a QoQ recovery in Anarock data for the Sept quarter; it sees no softness in customer decision-making despite rate-hike and AI concerns.
Kolkata villa pricing was raised to ~INR1.6 crore ticket size for three-bedroom villas, with four- and five-bedroom villas selling out within 30 days.
Management sees ~INR70-80 crores of additional P&L impact over 12-18 months from the JV acquisitions; the company has a 25% IRR threshold for new projects.
Management is expecting a return to EBITDA margins in the mid-20s on a normalised basis, with cost inflation said to be built into pricing and budgets.

qa_highlights.question: Are FY28 targets (INR2,500 crores revenue, 10% PBT) still on track, and why was the slide missing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the targets are intact and cited INR4,600 crores of revenue yet to be recognised from ongoing projects over 12-24 months. The slide was missing because the Board was still reviewing it; about 6 million sq ft of the 17.4 million sq ft upcoming pipeline is slow-moving.

qa_highlights.question: Why did H2 launches slip and why is YoY performance down?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said FY27 launches were planned to be H2-weighted, with only one Q2 launch deferred (Manjari, Pune, now Q3); Q2 FY26 had three significant launches. Management said H2 completions will drive revenue.

qa_highlights.question: How was the JV acquisition funded and what was the cash outflow?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR200 crores of JV debt was assumed plus INR37 crores consideration for the 50% stake in the three JVs; the ASK exit cost about INR300 crores, including INR100 crores extra, with the net debt increase of about INR300 crores.

qa_highlights.question: How much revenue will the consolidated JVs add, and is it included in guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Total GDV of the three JVs is about INR1,800 crores, of which only part is incremental. Management said it would not revise guidance for this.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue guidance was corrected to INR1,500-1,600 crores, and EBITDA to around INR300 crores (20%+ margin). The initial INR1,300-1,500 crores range was a misstatement.

qa_highlights.question: What is the leverage outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects only INR200-250 crores more net debt before March; comfort zone is 0.7-0.75 debt-to-equity, with a preference to stay below 0.5, versus 0.5:1 currently (INR700 crores net debt).

risks_watch: H2 revenue depends on timely OC and handovers: 107 Southeast (~796 pending units) and Sunshine Two (~776 units, subject to completion and approval).

FY27 guidance requires an increase from INR543 crores H1 revenue to INR1,500-1,600 crores, implying a strong H2; the guidance correction on the call (INR1,300-1,500 crores to INR1,500-1,600 crores) warrants attention.
Net debt more than doubled to INR761 crores; net debt-to-equity rose from 0.29 to 0.51, with ~11% average borrowing cost.
About 6 million sq ft of upcoming pipeline has slow approvals, and the FY28 slide was not published; watch for a formal re-statement.
Cost inflation risk to margins on sold projects; Manjari and Gateway C-Zone launch timing depends on approvals.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand, H2 execution and FY28 targets, but defensive on the missing FY28 slide and guidance corrections made during the call. Management was candid on the leverage rise and the approval-dependent slippage.
key_quotes: We remain aligned with our FY2 7 guidance and have good visibility on stronger revenue and earnings momentum through the balance of the year.
We are confident of achieving our full year guidance.
So we'll not quietly pull out that target from everybody.
We would not be very comfortable beyond 0.7, 0.75 as a kind of comfort zone.

growth.why: FY27 revenue recognition guided at INR1,500-1,600 crore (~20% growth), backed partly by ~INR1,400 crore of OC-led handovers still ahead and 5.25 million sq ft of H2 launches subject to approvals, with Manjari already slipped a quarter; FY28 targets held but under review.

oneOffs.what: Five JVs and three key projects converted into wholly owned subsidiaries; consolidation adds revenue and debt from H2 onward, with ~INR70-80 crore additional P&L impact over 12-18 months

quality.why: Q2 revenue rose 19% YoY to INR272 crore and PAT rose 151% YoY to INR21.6 crore, but the brief gives no volume or price split, and the JV consolidation is a non-recurring step-up that is not quantified for Q2 itself, while the brief does not say what share of Q2 revenue came from consolidated entities.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin ~23% (INR62.4 crores on INR272 crores revenue) and FY27 EBITDA guided at ~INR300 crores (20%+), with management expecting a return to mid-20s margins on a normalised basis as cost inflation is built into pricing.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Five JVs and three key projects were consolidated into wholly owned subsidiaries (~INR1,800 crores GDV), Manjari (~2.3 million sq ft) slipped to Q3 pending approvals, and Gateway C-Zone is targeted for Q4; these are project-level additions rather than new plants.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Q2 sales rose ~20% QoQ to INR583 crores on 0.91 million sq ft, H1 sales were INR1,067 crores on 1.76 million sq ft, and 5.25 million sq ft of H2 launches are planned across 9 projects, though subject to approvals.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Business development pipeline of ~8.8-9 million sq ft (~INR7,500-8,000 crores GDV) is at documentation stage with 21 projects under evaluation, and a Mumbai/MMR entry is being evaluated, but no firm land commitments were quantified and net debt is capped at a preferred sub-0.5 debt-to-equity.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue guidance was already corrected upward to INR1,500-1,600 crores, which requires H1 revenue of INR543 crores to nearly triple in H2, and management said it would not revise guidance for the JV consolidation.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H2 revenue depends on OC-led handovers of ~INR1,400 crores plus 5.25 million sq ft of approval-dependent launches, with Manjari already slipped a quarter, 107 Southeast (~796 pending units) and Sunshine Two (~776 units) subject to completion and approval, and the guidance was misstated on the call.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Manjari (~2.3 million sq ft) moves to Q3, Gateway C-Zone is targeted for Q4, and Bengaluru launches at Bannerghatta Road, Yelahanka, Doddagubbi and Sarjapura are planned Nov-Feb, though all depend on approvals.

rows.label: H2 handovers drive FY27 revenue (OC-led ~INR1,400 crores)
rows.why: Management guides OC-led handovers of ~INR1,400 crores still ahead, which is needed to lift H1 revenue of INR543 crores to the INR1,500-1,600 crores FY27 guide.

rows.label: Net debt rise capped at INR200-250 crores before March
rows.why: Net debt was INR761 crores (debt-to-equity 0.51, up from 0.29), management expects only INR200-250 crores more before March, and it prefers to stay below 0.5 debt-to-equity, though its comfort zone is 0.7-0.75.

rows.label: Kolkata villa pricing up
rows.why: Three-bedroom villa ticket size raised to ~INR1.6 crore and four- and five-bedroom villas selling out within 30 days, with Kolkata about 50% of H1 revenue and ~75% of plotted development sold.

tone.note: Management was confident on demand, H2 execution and FY28 targets (INR5,000 crores pre-sales, INR2,500 crores revenue) and candid on the net debt rise, but defensive on the missing FY28 slide and the guidance correction made mid-call; analysts pressed on the guidance and approval-dependent launches.
